I am severely disabled from birth and have chronic kidney disease. The GPs treated me like a hypercondriact, condescended to me and talked over me about my own health constantly.

I would start every appointment asking if they had read my notes, and they would say that they had, and then in the very next sentance say something that showed me they had not even read my notes summary (which I had to write myself because the practice never summarised my notes after six months).

They didn't seem to have the willingness to work alongside a patient who was knowedeable about their own condition and constantly tried to talk me out of asking for the bare minimum, like relevent referrals, regular blood tests, and them communicating with my specialists. This attitude put my life at risk at least once.

The only thing they would talk to specialists about was my trans status, to the point that they would try to blame a lot of symptoms on my being trans and on HRT with no evidence or based on wild assumptions about my body. It should be noted I only joined this practice because they offer HRT services, however I had to explain to one nurse how to do my testosterone shot myself and on one occasion I was jabbed way too high and dangerously close to my sciatic nerve.

I recently discovered that a referral I asked for the week I registered with them was not completed for months, and when it was it was done by a Dr I had never met or interacted with, who reduced all the detailed clinical information and symptoms I had provided into a single line that stated I was finding the pain "bothersome."

These GPs either do not have the ability or simply don't have the desire to support disabled and chornically ill patients, however I have no doubt they would be able to handle run of the mill GP services for those with one off conditions.",null,[0,185]]]],[null,1765049327000000,1765470083000000,"Edited 3 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/1571530995760771426/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFSTTFSVk5YVlNTRkpIV1ZSc2FsSlVRbXhWUlVwYVpGaFdSR0p1WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1571530995760771426/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFSTTFSVk5YVlNTRkpIV1ZSc2FsSlVRbXhWUlVwYVpGaFdSR0p1WXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/1571530995760771426/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFSTTFSVk5YVlNTRkpIV1ZSc2FsSlVRbXhWUlVwYVpGaFdSR0p1WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1571530995760771426/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFSTTFSVk5YVlNTRkpIV1ZSc2FsSlVRbXhWUlVwYVpGaFdSR0p1WXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/1571530995760771426/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFSTTFSVk5YVlNTRkpIV1ZSc2FsSlVRbXhWUlVwYVpGaFdSR0p1WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1571530995760771426/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFSTTFSVk5YVlNTRkpIV1ZSc2FsSlVRbXhWUlVwYVpGaFdSR0p1WXhBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Unfortunately despite weekly or twice weekly contacts with various members of the practice team - GP partners, locum doctors, ANP's, nurses, pharmacists etc,  you remained unhappy and complained about virtually every clinician who tried to attend to your needs.
